name: nov-19-29-thanksgiving
note: Thanksgiving carts campaign (brief Nov 19): seven iEatz-built Instacart carts, Pinterest pins to the carts, Instagram to the /thanksgiving hub. Truth rules: leftover ingredients only, never leftover dishes; the carts are not in the app; app CTA only on leftover-ingredient content; no prices; disclosure in every cart pin description. Own photos only (F-008).

posts.head:
Friendsgiving for five
fits in one cart.

msgs.text: ok who is doing the turkey
i can bring a side? maybe
nobody is cooking a whole bird for five people
sent the group the iEatz cart. turkey breast, sides, pie. done

posts.foot: The Friendsgiving cart is already built on Instacart. Open it, take out what you have, order the rest.
posts.photoClaim: a wooden dinner table at night with lit candles, a cutting board of sliced steak, a bowl of broccoli, a bowl of ravioli with parsley and pink napkins
posts.why: Every Friendsgiving starts as a group chat where nobody wants the turkey; the pin shows the moment one person ends the thread by sending the whole cart.
posts.app: No app claim on this pin: the Friendsgiving cart is an iEatz-built Instacart list and the pin links straight to it.

posts.head: Thanksgiving for ten starts with one tap.

card.head: Turkey, stuffing, cranberry, gravy, potatoes and pie.
card.body: The classic table for eight to ten, already in an Instacart cart. Open it and order.

posts.photoClaim: a holiday plate on an orange plaid runner: sliced turkey, mashed potatoes, stuffing, candied sweet potatoes and a green salad, small pumpkins and a paper towel roll behind it
posts.why: Hosting ten is the scariest grocery trip of the year; a real plate with the whole classic spread, circled, says the list is already done.
posts.app: No app claim on this pin: the classic cart is an iEatz-built Instacart list and the pin links straight to it.

posts.why: The week before Thanksgiving everyone is building the same list from scratch; nine slides say it is already built, seven ways, and the only decision left is which table is yours.
posts.app: No app claim on this post: the carts are iEatz-built Instacart lists and the hub page links to them; the app is only mentioned on the hub's After Thursday section.

slides.head:
Seven Thanksgiving
carts. Pick yours.
slides.body: We built the full grocery list for seven different tables on Instacart. Swipe to find yours, then open it from the link in bio.

slides.head:
The classic table
feeds eight to ten.
slides.body: Turkey, stuffing, cranberry, gravy, potatoes and pie. The cart most tables are picturing.

slides.head:
Friendsgiving gets
a turkey breast
and six plates.
slides.body: A turkey breast instead of a whole bird, with the sides right-sized for four to six.

slides.head:
You said you would
bring the green
bean casserole.
slides.body: Everything for one green bean casserole that serves eight to ten, and nothing you have to go back for.

slides.head:
The budget table
is the same
table for less.
slides.body: A frozen bird, store brands, canned and boxed sides where they hold up fine.

slides.head:
Southern soul food
starts with the
mac and cheese.
slides.body: Mac and cheese, collards with smoked turkey wings, candied yams and sweet potato pie.

slides.head:
Vegetarian puts
a stuffed squash
in the middle.
slides.body: A stuffed butternut squash as the centerpiece, with a mushroom gravy. Vegetarian, not vegan.

slides.head:
Premium means
a fresh bird
and two pies.
slides.body: A fresh bird, scratch sides, two pies, a cheese board and cider. For the year it has to show.
